Rules: Always use `--format`/`--tail`/`--no-trunc` style flags and cap output; never dump full build or container logs.
Inspecting (ps, images, logs, inspect, stats, compose ps/config) is always fine. Starting/stopping/building/compose up-down of what the prompt names is fine.

Destructive commands (rm, rmi, volume rm, network rm, system/image/container/volume prune, compose down -v, kill) need an AUTHORIZED block listing the exact targets. Never run any `prune` without one.
Never mount host system directories or run `--privileged` unless the prompt says so explicitly.

CliTools.Name: docker
CliTools.UseCase: Containers, images, compose stacks. Example: `docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}'`, `docker logs --tail 200 <c>`, `docker compose ps`.
